name: RfqQuoteResponseBuilder
tagline: The RFQ Quote Response Builder is the form a supplier uses to answer a request for quotation (RFQ).
description: The RFQ Quote Response Builder is the form a supplier uses to answer a request for quotation (RFQ). The buyer publishes the lines to be quoted; the supplier enters a unit price, discount and lead time for each line - or marks it No bid or offers an Alternative - and the control works out every line total, the delivery date, tax and the grand total as they type.
features: Prices every requested line (unit price, discount, lead time, bid / no bid / alternative offer)
Flags prices above the buyer's target and deliveries later than the need-by date
Tax and grand total, captures currency, validity, Incoterms, payment terms
Stores the whole response (with a readable summary) as JSON in one text column
